title: The Live Composer WordPress plugin before 2.1.24 does not sanitise and escape some of its module settings before…
description: The Live Composer WordPress plugin versions before 2.1.24 do not properly sanitise and escape certain module settings before outputting them in href attributes. This vulnerability allows high-privilege users, such as administrators, to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) attacks even if the unfiltered_html capability is disabled, for example in multisite WordPress setups.
